review_only_repairs.counterfactual_hidden_quality: Not measured in the preregistered run
review_only_repairs.notes: c0 is the strongest implementation and the only one that clears the visible cumulative matrix, but it still misses a hidden stage-3 requirement around reconcile validation/error mapping. In domain.py, top-level reconcile and inner batch reconcile do not reject duplicate sku entries in counts during shape validation, even though the spec requires duplicate sku values to return {"error":"invalid"}. In service.py, _run_mutation catches ValueError from reconcile_stock only for the "insufficient" case; a duplicate-sku reconcile currently escapes as an unhandled exception and the CLI reports {"error":"internal"} instead of {"error":"invalid"}. Repair by enforcing unique sku validation in _validate_reconcile, and/or by mapping storage duplicate errors to DomainError("invalid") in the reconcile path. Ensure the same behavior applies for reconcile inside batch so duplicate counts are rejected before any state changes and never surface as internal errors.

caveats: Descriptive read-only analysis; run sustained_audit for evidence binding verification.
Primary outcomes are final requirement coverage and whole-project completion.
Raw losing-proposal regressions are exploratory branch diagnostics, not a policy-quality numerator.
A builder continuation or malformed completion artifact is not necessarily a software defect.
Historical private checks are retrospective and never supplied as agent repair feedback.
Passing-visible reviewer repairs need counterfactual private evaluation before claiming measured hidden lift.
While the study is running, finalized policies have unequal sample counts.
